issues.cause: core sends the enriched settlePayload to facilitator but passes the original context.paymentPayload to afterSettle; the auth-capture hook therefore does not see type=capture and does not update stored balances.
issues.recovery: Operator calls canonical Escrow.refund directly after checking the public chain state. This bypasses the stale SDK storage, not the contract permissions.
